summary: Iteration 7 tested isolated, persistent workspaces on the cloud target. Backend: the new tests/test_iter7_workspaces.py passes 6 of 6. It covers label CRUD, cookie isolation, pause-all and resume-all across 2 workspaces with real GPT runs, the agent seeing the client label, and 401 without a token. The restart script /app/tests/restart_persist_check.py ran a real `supervisorctl restart backend`; 13 of 14 checks passed, and the one miss was an artifact of the check itself, not a bug. Regression: test_iter5_groups.py and test_iter6_fixes.py pass 18 of 18 (the parallel GPT test was not run), and test_shadow_api.py passes 20 of 20. Cookie isolation, verified on frame screenshots: workspace A's httpbin /cookies shows only ws=a, B shows only ws=b, Main shows only its own older cookie, and a fresh workspace shows {}. Restart: groups were back about 6.7s after the restart. The same ids, names, labels, tab URLs and active tab came back for Main, PATOG and 2 TEST workspaces. The R1 cookie (restart=r1) survived the restart and R2 still had no cookies. A run active at the restart became 'paused' with the 'Interrupted by a restart' summary and stayed paused (it did not auto-resume). Resume finished it in the same workspace id with 'The page title is: Example Domain', and the workspace was not renamed to 'Resumed:'. Agent prompt: the run in workspace 'TEST_Mercy' labelled 'Mercy Hospital TESTX' answered 'This workspace is for client/company: Mercy Hospital TESTX.' UI, all verified: New workspace dialog (fields, cancel, create with start page; the new workspace is selected and shows example.com), chip label, pencil edit with prefilled fields and no URL field in edit mode, double-click opening the dialog, grid tile labels, and the solo page showing 'Workspace · name · label' with title 'Shadow · name'. Pause all is enabled only while a task runs, Resume all only while one is paused. Toasts read 'Paused 1 workspace task(s) — you have control' and 'Resumed 1 workspace task(s)'. The background finish toast 'TEST_UI_ws2: Task finished' appeared while on Main.

issues: Solo-page label uses text-slate-500 on #08090E, which is low contrast; slate-400 is suggested. Chip and tile labels are 10px text at #00F0FF/70, readable but small.

action_items: Optional (LOW): raise the contrast of the solo-page label.
critical_code_review_comments: Startup only converts 'running' runs to 'paused'. Runs in waiting_input or awaiting_approval at a restart stay in that state, which is fine because the user's reply or approval calls engine.start. The summary text is overwritten on those paused runs, though.

Race: group_close pops the group then unlinks <id>.json. autosave/save_states iterates a snapshot of list(groups), so a save in flight can rewrite the state file after the unlink and leave an orphaned cookies file on disk. Ids are random hex so the impact is low, but consider a lock or an unlink after the save.
save_workspaces skips saving if no workspace has tabs. That is fine, but a session whose browser crashed (closed=True) also never saves, so the last autosave (up to 10s old) is what gets restored.
pause-all and resume-all run serially; resume-all calls runs_resume for each run (each may open a browser context). That is fine for 10 runs or fewer.
server.py is 1046 lines and shadow_browser.py 890. Splitting them into routers/modules is still recommended.
